name: Pearson VUE OnVUE
summary: Online proctored exam delivery service for professional and vendor certification programmes.

value: Support candidate identity checks, secure testing environments and exam programme operations

value.notes: Exam fees vary by certification sponsor and programme; not a general institutional SaaS price.
